event.title: England Storm
event.summary: Huge waves, uprooted trees and damaged boats mark Storm Austen's arrival in France and the UK. Gusts of up to 160 km/h have battered Brittany, while fallen branches have blocked roads in southern England.

revisions.title: Storm Austen Hits France and UK with 160 km/h Winds
revisions.summary: Storm Austen has caused significant damage in France and the UK, with winds reaching up to 160 km/h. In Brittany, huge waves and uprooted trees have been reported, while southern England has experienced blocked roads due to fallen branches and damaged boats.
key_facts: Storm Austen brought winds of up to 160 km/h.
Brittany experienced huge waves and uprooted trees.
Southern England faced blocked roads from fallen branches.
